subject: Forecast cleanroom roll-call + leadership packet intake
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Nov 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Forecast cleanroom roll-call + leadership packet intake

Team —

We need to run the monthly cleanroom for Q4 forecasts and assemble the leadership packet for the upcoming 11/18 review. Goal is twofold: (1) lock commit-ready opportunities and (2) produce the one-page stage summary for the exec binder.

Quick ask: can each manager own the following by EOD 11/10?
- Confirm stage and next action for all deals > $50k in your book (column: final_next_action in the tracking sheet)
- Flag any regressions or quality concerns (reason + suggested mitigation)
- Upload a short one-line justification for each commit (1-2 sentences)

I've attached the leadership_pack_template.xlsx and a tracking CSV (tracking_sheet_JL_shared.csv). Please use the tracking CSV as the system of record for commits — I will pull the exec packet from it on 11/11 morning.

Process notes:
- Use "Commitable" vs "At-Risk" tags in the sheet — we'll use those to drive the executive extract.
- If you need a quick sanity sync, book a 15-min slot on my calendar; I’m blocking 11/10 9:00–12:00 PT for manager triage.

I'll compile the draft leadership one-pager and circulate on 11/11 for review. If any deal requires a pre-read to execs, flag it and include the one-off deck in the Drive link.

Thanks — this is the last scrub before the QBR packet, want to avoid late surprises.

—
Jasmine Liu
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0162

Attachments: leadership_pack_template.xlsx (xlsx), tracking_sheet_JL_shared.csv (csv)

2) If a deal is legal/redline blocked but we have verbal commit, should that be marked Committable with caveat?

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the heads-up. We’re in the middle of our own procurement cycle and may need to shift paperwork timelines. A couple quick asks from our side: 

- Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept a PoA (purchase order + signed SOW) as the commitment artifact, or do you require countersigned MSA first?
- If the exec packet calls out our renewal as "Commitable", please note we expect final PO by 11/20; legal is aiming to finish redlines by 11/16.

I’ve looped in procurements to keep the channel open. We’ll do our best to hit the 11/11 note but wanted to surface potential timing slippage.

Best,
Ellis G.
Director of Vendor Ops
Nimbus Health
procurements@NimbusHealth.com

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Ellis Graham <ellis.graham@nimbushealth.com>, procurements@NimbusHealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Nov 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Forecast cleanroom roll-call + leadership packet intake

Ellis — thanks for the note and for flagging procurement timing. Quick replies inline and next steps: 

- Commitment artifact: We will treat a signed PO + SOW as a valid commitment for the purposes of the leadership packet. MSA countersign is preferred but not required to mark a deal Committable; please include the expected PO date in the tracking sheet.
- For reporting value: use ARR-equivalent (annualized) in the commit column; add full contract value in the notes field if it materially alters exec decisioning.
- Legal redlines: mark as "Committable (legal pending)" and include the redline owner and target completion date in the tracking sheet. I will call out those caveated items explicitly in the one-pager.

Action items for Nimbus Health: procurements to add expected PO date in tracking CSV; Ellis, if your legal can drop the redline completion target I’ll reflect that in the exec note.

Manager action items (recap):
- All managers: complete the tracking CSV by EOD 11/10 (final_next_action + commit justification)
- Markus: confirm reporting model for multi-year renewals (per above) — thanks for surfacing
- Marissa/Grace: I’ll pull the leadership one-pager 11/11 08:00 PT and circulate for 1-hour review. Please be prepared for 1 round of edits.

I’ve uploaded commit_summary_Q4_v2.pdf which will be the source for the one-pager extract. Drive link and HubSpot reference included above.

If there are any last-minute large edits, ping me on Slack (#pipeline-ops) so I can triage before the pull.

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround.

—
Jasmine Liu
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0162
